records.alt: Light-colored dune field beside a winding river amid vast green forest and dark green hills.
records.caption: Landsat scene of the Great Kobuk Sand Dunes in Alaska; one example among North America's varied natural environments.

records.title: Earth's thin atmospheric layers
records.summary: An ISS astronaut photograph catches the curved edge of the atmosphere in layers of warm light and blue haze beneath a crescent Moon.
records.alt: Thin red-orange atmospheric layer topped by blue and black space, with a small Moon crescent above.
records.caption: The atmospheric limb provides a natural cross-section: reddish scattering in the lower atmosphere, blues higher up, and space beyond.

records.title: Spiral clouds of Hurricane Dorian
records.summary: NASA's Aqua MODIS sensor imaged the broad white spiral cloud bands of Hurricane Dorian as it crossed the northern Bahamas on September 1, 2019.
records.alt: Huge white cyclonic cloud system with a distinct eye over blue ocean and islands near Florida and the Bahamas.
records.caption: A planetary-scale cloud system viewed in natural color from orbit; the structured spiral reveals the dynamics of a tropical cyclone.
